title: Supplier profile
syntheticNotice: Demo mode: this profile is built from synthetic data and does not describe a real company.

error.notFound: INN {inn} is neither in the procurement data nor among the curated external candidates.
error.invalidInn: An INN has 10 digits (legal entity) or 12 digits (individual entrepreneur).
error.unavailable: The profile could not be loaded. Try again later.

header.nameUnknown: Company name not established — profile not enriched yet

actions.label: Profile actions
actions.enrichingHint: Checking the FNS registry, the company website and contacts. This can take up to a minute.
actions.enrichCached: The stored profile is still current — sources were not queried again
actions.enrichFailedHint: Sources were unavailable or did not respond. Previously stored data is shown.

enrichment.notEnrichedTitle: Supplier profile has not been enriched yet.
enrichment.notEnriched: Only procurement data and curated facts (if any) are shown. Legal details and contacts appear after enrichment.
enrichment.notEnrichedNoAction: Only procurement data and curated facts (if any) are shown.
enrichment.inProgress: The profile is being updated. Reload the page in a minute.
enrichment.partial: Legal details come from the official EGRUL. Some information (website, contacts) is not available yet — this is an expected result, not an error.
enrichment.failed: Sources did not respond. Data already in the system is shown.
enrichment.failedFinal: Sources did not confirm details for this INN. Retrying will not help.

reason.REGISTRY_NOT_FOUND: INN not found in the registry
reason.PRIMARY_REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE_MIRROR_USED: Official EGRUL unavailable — optional secondary provider used
reason.LEGAL_ENTITY_CEASED: The legal entity has ceased operations
reason.INDIVIDUAL_ENTREPRENEUR_CONTACTS_NOT_COL: Contacts of individual entrepreneurs are not collected
reason.NO_PUBLIC_PHONE_OR_EMAIL_ON_OFFICIAL_SIT: No phone or email on the official website

identity.title: Legal identity
identity.subtitle: From the registry. The company role is shown separately.
identity.unavailable: Legal details have not been retrieved from the registry yet.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.none: Verified contact information has not yet been discovered.
contacts.noneHint: Phone, email and website are shown only once the company's own website is identified and confirmed. The official EGRUL legal address is shown when available.
contacts.noneEntrepreneur: Contacts of individual entrepreneurs are not collected (personal data).

freshness.title: Data freshness
freshness.note: Checked recently is not the same as fresh: an outdated page stays stale and an undated page stays unknown.

roles.title: Company role
roles.subtitle: Roles need evidence and do not follow from the legal identity.

statusHint.INFERRED: Inferred from indirect signals — not confirmed
statusHint.HISTORY: Supplies observed in the organizer procurement data. This is not manufacturer or distributor evidence.

roles.unknownDescription: Checked sources contain no evidence of a role (manufacturer, distributor).
roles.marketUnknownDescription: Checked sources contain no manufacturing or distribution evidence. OKVED alone never makes a company a manufacturer.

basis.FIRST_PARTY_PRODUCTION_CLAIM: Production claim on the company website
basis.FIRST_PARTY_DISTRIBUTION_CLAIM: Distribution claim on the company website

history.title: Observed procurement history
history.disclaimer: History observed in the organizer procurement data (2024–2025) — not the company's total market activity.
history.noAwardsOkpd2: No awarded items with an OKPD2 code.
history.none: The organizer procurement data has no records for this INN.
history.external: This company does not appear in the organizer procurement data — it is an external candidate. No history does not mean no experience.

sources.title: Sources & evidence
sources.summary: {sources, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} · {evidence, plural, one {# evidence item} other {# evidence items}}
sources.attemptsNote: The secondary provider is optional: when it is rate-limited or skipped, the official EGRUL data still applies.

fixtures.title: Supplier 360 — demo states
fixtures.description: Synthetic profiles for checking the screen in mock mode. In live mode the profile opens from a supplier card.
fixtures.partial: Partial profile · stale contacts · inferred distributor
fixtures.noContacts: Individual entrepreneur · no contacts · unknown freshness

sourceClass.SECONDARY_PROVIDER: Optional secondary provider — not an official registry
